Definition

What is a Piezo Buzzer?

  • Generates sound
  • Makes a beep
  • Can even play the melody of a song

Tap the buzzer → it beeps (a different pitch each tap)

Wiring

Two pins

Tap the − or + button to see where each pin connects.

How it works

How does a piezo buzzer work?

tone(buzzer, 1000);noTone(buzzer);

1000 Hz (pitch)

The wave is how fast the pin switches ON/OFF

Notes & frequencies

Play the piano keys

tone(buzzer, 261);

C4 = 261 Hz
